Id ceiling (inclusive): 5858037824. SHA at dispatch: d9b031c1a352b0d09f00f85028db9673d36ddd6f (HEAD matches; pin reads via git show).

Refutation target under test: it is acceptable that proveLiveThreadCompletedArcForIngestReady / applyIngestReadyRemainingSet stamp design-critique:ingest-ready after evaluateCompletedArcRecord alone, without evaluateTargetDigestAdmission on the live REST issue body, because digest admission is an ingest-only gate and the chip is list state.

## Digest-is-ingest-only already fails for standing list state
blocks-the-design
Evidence: At d9b031c1a352b0d09f00f85028db9673d36ddd6f, `git show` on `packages/core/src/design-critique/completed-arc-record.ts` shows `proveLiveThreadCompletedArcForIngestReady` returns only `evaluateCompletedArcRecord({ comments })`, and `applyIngestReadyRemainingSet` takes `(client, repo, issueNumber, comments)` with no live-body input and zero calls to `evaluateTargetDigestAdmission` before `writeDesignCritiqueCatalogRemainingSet(..., "design-critique:ingest-ready")`. `git grep evaluateTargetDigestAdmission` at that SHA hits `issue-ingest.ts` and `scm/design-critique-stale-ready.ts`. The stale-ready path, on a complete record, calls `evaluateTargetDigestAdmission({ citedLeanBody, liveIssueBody: viewed.body })` and reports mismatch as a standing ingest-ready problem. Chip usage text and #4700 comments already refuse ingest-ready writes unless live-thread completed-arc is complete; both `runDesignCritiqueChip` and `ScmLabelClient.apply` exclusive fold call the same thin helper. Issue body verified evidence on #4988: complete + stale-target concurrently, and `applyIngestReadyRemainingSet` still returned ok with a mocked label write.
Failure mode: Binding the target keeps the shared ingest-ready write authority able to mint a catalog chip that the product's own standing-list scanner already classifies as digest-stale on the same live REST body, while `issue:ingest` refuses that body as stale-target. Operators and punchlist treat the chip as ingest-ready list state; the later verb then fails on a stamp that the write helper already had enough cited-lean + live-body inputs to refuse. Shared-state / injection lens: chip verb and label reconciler share one omit, so neither caller can force digest admission today.
Disposition: The refutation target cannot bind. Write-time proof for ingest-ready must compose the existing `evaluateTargetDigestAdmission` against the live REST issue body (and the cited lean from the completed-arc verdict) at the shared `applyIngestReadyRemainingSet` boundary before any label mutation. Preserve current unpinned and #4700 completed-arc/pain semantics; refuse mismatch with zero writes; do not auto-edit bodies, silently normalize digest bytes, or sweep standing labels (#4970 stays diagnosis of already-standing chips).

## List-state does not license minting known-false readiness
sharpens-framing
Evidence: Contract text at the dispatch SHA keeps catalog chips as list-visible convenience and ⊗ Treat the ingest-ready chip as clearance, and Keep chip design-critique:ingest-ready as list state. The same contract already required live-thread completed-arc proof before that remaining-set write (#4700). `applyDesignCritiqueCatalogChip` no-ops ingest-ready so the only write path is `applyIngestReadyRemainingSet`.
Failure mode: Reading "list state" as permission to omit digest collapses #4700's write-time honesty pattern: completed-arc was composed at the chip write without turning the chip into clearance. Omitting digest while keeping completed-arc creates a half-honest list signal specifically for the #4243 pin the later verb enforces.
Disposition: Keep list-state / not-clearance. State the bound remedy as composing the existing digest evaluator into the existing shared write proof, matching the issue proposed scope, rather than defending the omission as an ingest-only concern.

## Road-not-taken: post-mint #4970 scan as the only digest control
footnote
Evidence: `scm:issue:design-critique-stale-ready` is read-only and already applies digest admission to standing ingest-ready candidates; ingest separately refuses stale-target.
Failure mode if chosen as the exclusive control: the write still succeeds first, so list and punchlist show ready until a later scan or ingest. That is recovery after false mint, not admission at the shared write.
Disposition: Inventory only. Prefer refuse-before-write at `applyIngestReadyRemainingSet` over scan-after-mint as the primary control for new ready-label writes.

The refutation target does not survive.

metadata.issueBody:
## Summary

The guarded ingest-ready writer proves that the live comment thread has a completed arc, but does not apply target-digest admission. It can therefore stamp a fresh `design-critique:ingest-ready` label while `issue:ingest` would reject the same issue as `stale-target`.

This is distinct from #4970: that issue addresses previously accepted records invalidated by later gates and the diagnosis of standing labels. This issue covers the admission check for a new ready-label write.

## Verified evidence

Verified on 2026-09-23 against source commit `cae371d0161bb7c03df0ab9fc312c477f7c524cc`, using live REST body and comments for #4988.

- `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` returns `complete`.
- `evaluateTargetDigestAdmission` on its cited lean and exact REST issue body returns `blocked / stale-target`.
- Current body SHA-256: `33284bb9c42e930a72ccdf8cf9f0b6407d90c43ec6881259130b0e18ee8138a5`.
- Pinned digest: `bca90f1dd0c0d288c4f6192e79941b1e9eccbeb4f76e245c9c5ab671b4a6b7bb`.
- Hashing that body with one additional trailing newline produces the pinned digest. This explains the observed mismatch without establishing when or how it was authored.
- Calling `applyIngestReadyRemainingSet` with that live thread and a fake label client initially containing `bug` plus `design-critique:mechanism-shaped` returns `ok: true` and makes one mocked apply: add ingest-ready, remove mechanism-shaped.
- No live labels were changed by the reproduction.

The source path is `packages/core/src/design-critique/completed-arc-record.ts`: `proveLiveThreadCompletedArcForIngestReady` calls only `evaluateCompletedArcRecord`; the write helper has no live-body input. Ingest additionally checks `evaluateTargetDigestAdmission` in `packages/core/src/intake/issue-ingest.ts`.

Earlier evidence: [#4970 round-4 audit](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4970#issuecomment-5803103366). Prior write-proof scope: #4700.

## Proposed scope

Compose existing completed-record and exact-live-body digest admission at the shared ready-label write boundary used by both the chip verb and the label reconciler. Reuse the existing evaluator rather than duplicate its parsing. Acquire the live issue body through the canonical SCM surface; cache or caller assertions must not replace live proof.

Preserve #4700's completed-arc/pain checks and current digest semantics, including the documented handling of unpinned records. Refuse a digest mismatch before label mutation. Do not add automatic body edits, silently normalize digest bytes, or sweep/remove standing labels.

## Acceptance criteria

- A frozen complete-thread fixture with a mismatching pinned digest causes zero label writes and reports stale-target.
- Exact matching body/digest permits the existing ready transition.
- The trailing-newline mismatch above is covered without live GitHub dependence.
- Both ready-write callers exercise the shared proof; neither can bypass digest admission.
- Body/comment fetch failure refuses the write without reporting readiness.
- Existing completed-arc failures and documented unpinned behavior retain their current semantics.

expected_outputs: ingest-ready write refuses stale-target before label mutation
